reason: Any merchant identity string found in src/ (outside the isolated design preview) means a merchant leaked into the platform code. The platform renders ANY merchant from StoreProfile content; a store name, tagline, contact domain or address committed to source breaks that silently. Matching is case-insensitive and Arabic is compared with diacritics (U+064B-U+0652) and tatweel stripped. Derived from every fixture merchant: the preview/store-a merchant (src/preview/fixtures/catalog.ts, store-platform-staff/scripts/fixtures/stores/store-a.mjs) and the second-store fixture (store-b.mjs). A new fixture merchant adds its identity here.
